domain: Hospital patient monitoring system for post-operative care.

glossary.definition: The attending physician responsible for a ward during a given shift.
The process of notifying a higher-priority care provider when a lower-priority care action does not achieve the expected outcome.
Explicit confirmation recorded in the system when the duty physician receives and accepts an escalated alert.

business_rules.rule: An escalated alert must be acknowledged by the duty physician within 5 minutes; if no acknowledgment is recorded, the system must re-escalate to the on-call senior physician and log the missed acknowledgment with a timestamp.
